source: Optional Spanish recall during ordinary conversation
lessonTheme: Create an offer for a recipient
summary: Recalled crea una oferta and por favor. Recipient por needed para; nosotros uarios nuevos was corrected to nuestro cliente nuevo. A plural-users alternative was also supplied. No corrected retry observed.

observations.learnerText: crea una oferta por nosotros uarios nuevos, por favor
observations.correctedText: Crea una oferta para nuestro cliente nuevo, por favor.
observations.feedback: Crea una oferta recalled correctly. Para marks the recipient. Nuestro cliente means our customer; for our new users, para nuestros usuarios nuevos.

nextSteps: Recall una oferta para + recipient after intervening material; practise nuestro/nuestros with the intended noun.
assessmentNote: Command recalled successfully; recurring recipient-preposition error needs delayed review. No mastery or corrected retry inferred.
